verdict.rationale: Lithic's MCP integration lets external AI assistants (Cursor, Claude, Copilot) query docs and live API data and 'act on what they find,' and marketing mentions 'insights to action,' but there is no evidence of native, in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced directly to users from their own transaction/program data. Missing for 10: a first-party in-dashboard analytics/insights feature, concrete examples of AI-generated suggestions from customer data, and any independent corroboration beyond marketing copy.
